name: disclosure
need: Hide advanced settings or sections until asked, one at a time if needed

--ds-disclosure-height.description: a `.ds-disclosure` summary: the base height (size md, comfortable density) the size and density steps apply to; its rest radius is at most half of it

--ds-disclosure-radius.description: the plain summary (at most half the height, times `--ds-shape`)

--ds-disclosure-radius-pressed.description: the plain summary while pressed (times `--ds-shape`; never rounder than at rest)

--ds-disclosure-row-padding.description: the side padding of a row and its body: the base, 2px less per density step

--ds-disclosure-row-padding-exact.description: a fixed side padding that ignores density; a card sets it to `--ds-card-pad` so its rows run to its edges
